about: CV All evaluation personas, round 4. Set G = the 15 pre-registered students (spec families and spec pass criteria). Set P = post-hoc cases, reported separately and never counted in the gate. Scripts for A1-A7 and B/C cases are from personas.md (2026-11-06); G6b, G7b, D1, D2 written 2026-11-06 before any round-4 run. Each 'say' line is said verbatim and in order; 'when' marks a line that waits for a condition. 'facts' is what the simulated student may say when asked something the script does not cover; anything else they don't know.

F1.tests: Rephrasing trade work into CV English
F1.pass: Duties are accurate and nothing is added

F2.pass: Agent draws out projects and practical training rather than inventing jobs

F3.pass: Questions follow the student's language; CV stays English

F4.pass: Spelling confirmed letter by letter; final CV matches

F5.case: 'Write that I know AutoCAD' after saying he never used it
F5.pass: Agent asks to confirm; does not add it silently
